name: E-JUST National Postgraduate Scholarships (MoHE, Teaching Assistant and Private scholarships) – Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology
organization: Egypt-Japan University of Science and Technology (E-JUST), with the Egyptian Ministry of Higher Education (MoHE)

coverage_details.monthly_stipend: Not stated on E-JUST's official pages for the MoHE and private scholarships; Teaching Assistant scholars receive a salary package
coverage_details.additional_allowances: MoHE (governmental) scholarships are funded mainly by the Ministry of Higher Education for the time needed to finish the degree (M.Sc. and PhD within five years, preceded by a one-time research period of 6–12 months; PhD three years preceded by a research period of 3–12 months). Teaching Assistant scholars get a salary package, medical care and accommodation (single or family). E-JUST does not publish stipend amounts or say where the research period takes place.

eligibility.eligible_nationalities: Egyptian applicants (national postgraduate admission); MoHE scholarships are for demonstrators/teaching assistants and research assistants of governmental universities and research institutions
eligibility.gpa_requirement: MoHE Master's: bachelor's with at least 'Very Good'. Teaching Assistant scholarship: at least 'Very Good' or cumulative GPA of 3.0 or higher. Admission generally needs a strong academic record in the related field.
eligibility.language_requirements: TOEFL iBT 79 or Academic IELTS 6.5 (valid at the call's start date; original certificate required)
eligibility.age_limit: MoHE scholarship: at most 30 at the call date for Master's and at most 33 for PhD (no exceptions)
eligibility.field_restrictions: Research-based M.Sc./PhD in E-JUST's faculties: Engineering, Basic and Applied Sciences, Computer Science and Information Technology, International Business and Humanities, and Heritage Science. Applicants pick up to three research topics within one department. The Teaching Assistant scholarship covers engineering and basic/applied sciences only.
eligibility.return_obligation: Full-time scholarships: scholars may not work elsewhere during the scholarship. MoHE scholars are staff of Egyptian public universities/institutes and keep their affiliation.

nationality.note: National postgraduate admission is for Egyptian students (international students apply separately, e.g. TICAD8). Three tracks: (1) MoHE governmental scholarship for demonstrators/research assistants of governmental universities and research institutions with at least one year of service and an affiliated-faculty nomination; (2) E-JUST Teaching Assistant scholarship (teach undergraduates while studying; engineering and basic/applied sciences); (3) a limited number of private scholarships for M.Sc. students. All need military service completed or exempted (men).

language.note: Programmes are taught in English. TOEFL iBT 79 or Academic IELTS 6.5 is required for MoHE, Teaching Assistant and private scholarships; the certificate must be valid when the call opens.

field.note: Applicants choose research topics in one department of an E-JUST faculty; the academic background must match the faculty's table.

timeline.typical_deadline: Application submission in September 2026 for the current national cycle (exact closing day not published)
timeline.interview_period: Written entrance exam and personal/academic interview (with research-proposal presentation) after primary screening
timeline.result_announcement: After the entrance exams and interviews (date not published)
timeline.course_start: Not published for the current cycle

deadline.label: E-JUST national postgraduate application (MoHE / TA / private scholarships)
deadline.note: The official 'Procedures and deadlines' page lists 'Application Submission: September 2026' and leaves every later stage blank, so 30 September is only an end-of-month placeholder. name: ITI 9-Month Professional Training Program (Information Technology Institute, Egypt)

language.note: No IELTS/TOEFL needed; English is tested in ITI's own IQ & English exam during admission.

timeline.interview_period: After the July window: IQ & English exam, track exam, technical interview and final interview (exact dates not published)

name: LPDP Scholarship (Indonesia Endowment Fund for Education) – STEM Industri Strategis and SHARE, domestic or overseas
organization: Lembaga Pengelola Dana Pendidikan (LPDP), Ministry of Finance of the Republic of Indonesia

coverage_details.monthly_stipend: Monthly living allowance (Dana Hidup Bulanan); the amount depends on the study city/country and is set by LPDP (not stated in the 2026 booklets)
coverage_details.additional_allowances: Full scheme: education funds (registration fee, tuition/SPP/UKT, book allowance, thesis/dissertation research, international seminar, international journal publication) and support funds (transport, visa application, health insurance, arrival allowance, monthly living allowance, international competition, family allowance for PhD only, emergency funds). Funding lasts up to 24 months (Master) or 48 months (PhD). General and civil-servant applicants may instead choose a partial scheme where LPDP pays either the education costs or the support costs.

eligibility.eligible_nationalities: Indonesian citizens (Warga Negara Indonesia) under General, CPNS/PNS/TNI/POLRI or Affirmation (Papua, affirmation regions, low-income, disability) criteria
eligibility.gpa_requirement: General criteria: Master's applicants need a previous-degree GPA of at least 3.00/4.00; PhD applicants at least 3.25/4.00. Foreign degrees need diploma equivalency and GPA conversion from Kemendiktisaintek or the Ministry of Religious Affairs.
eligibility.language_requirements: Master in Indonesia: TOEFL ITP 500, TOEFL iBT 61, PTE 50, IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 105, TOEP 500 or a listed Indonesian university in-house test. Master abroad: TOEFL iBT 80, PTE 58, IELTS 6.5 or Duolingo 120. PhD in Indonesia: TOEFL ITP 530, iBT 70, PTE 50, IELTS 6.0, Duolingo 110 or TOEP 530. PhD abroad: TOEFL iBT 94, PTE 65, IELTS 7.0 or Duolingo 130. Certificates must be at most 2 years old. Not needed if you already hold an unconditional LoA that meets LPDP rules.
eligibility.age_limit: Age on 31 December of the application year, General criteria: Master at most 35, PhD at most 40 (permanent lecturers with NIDN/NUPTK: 42 / 47; CPNS/PNS: 37 / 42; researchers/engineers/medical staff/educators in the civil service: 42 / 47; TNI/POLRI: 40 / 45)
eligibility.field_restrictions: STEM Industri Strategis covers health, food security, digitalisation (AI and semiconductors), downstreaming and industrialisation, defence, advanced materials and manufacturing, energy and maritime, plus supporting public policy, law, business and economics, and entrepreneurship/creative industries. SHARE covers social sciences, humanities, arts, religious studies and education. Destination universities and programmes come from LPDP's lists; other domestic universities need A/Unggul accreditation (and a QS top-1,200 ranking for General applicants), other foreign ones an unconditional LoA plus proof of quality.
eligibility.return_obligation: Return to Indonesia within 90 days of graduating and contribute in Indonesia for at least twice the study period (2N), per the LPDP awardee guide (December 2025 edition).

nationality.note: Indonesian citizens only. Each applicant category (General, civil servant/TNI/POLRI, Affirmation) has its own extra requirements, e.g. civil servants need a proposal letter from an echelon-II official. Applicants who already hold a master's cannot apply for a master's (same for PhD).

language.note: IELTS 6.0 (or TOEFL ITP 500 / iBT 61, PTE 50, Duolingo 105) is the minimum for a Master's in Indonesia. Study abroad needs more: Master IELTS 6.5 (iBT 80), PhD IELTS 7.0 (iBT 94). A domestic PhD needs ITP 530 / iBT 70 / IELTS 6.0. An unconditional LoA that meets LPDP rules waives the certificate.

field.note: All fields can apply (STEM Industri Strategis or SHARE), but in 2026 the larger STEM Industri Strategis scheme targets strategic industries; SHARE covers social sciences, humanities, arts, religion and education.

timeline.typical_deadline: Tahap 2 2026 registration: 30 June – 31 July 2026. Tahap 1 usually closes around late February (2026 dates from news reports, not re-verified on an official page).
timeline.interview_period: Substance selection (interview) 14 October – 20 November 2026 for Tahap 2
timeline.course_start: Tahap 2 2026 awardees may start studying from January 2027

name: PTDF In-Country Scholarship Scheme (ISS) – Master's and PhD in Nigerian public universities
organization: Petroleum Technology Development Fund (PTDF), Federal Government of Nigeria

coverage_details.monthly_stipend: Not published in PTDF's official ISS guidelines; confirm the benefit package in the award letter
coverage_details.additional_allowances: PTDF describes the ISS as scholarships for undergraduate, Master's and PhD study in PTDF-upgraded Nigerian universities, but the 2026/27 guidelines do not list what the award pays. The coverage flags here are left false because they could not be verified, not because PTDF confirmed they are excluded.

eligibility.eligible_nationalities: Nigerians (selection balances the 36 States and the FCT)
eligibility.gpa_requirement: MSc: at least Second Class Lower (2:2) in an oil and gas-related first degree. PhD: at least 2:2 first degree plus at least a Merit second degree in an oil and gas-related discipline.
eligibility.language_requirements: No separate English test; five O-level credits (WAEC/SSCE/NECO) including English Language and Mathematics, in at most two sittings
eligibility.field_restrictions: Only PTDF-sponsored courses relevant to the oil and gas industry and its management, at approved Nigerian public universities: engineering (chemical, petroleum, petroleum & gas, mechanical, electrical, computer, civil, software, mechatronics, structural, water resources & environmental...), sciences (applied geology, geophysics, chemistry, industrial chemistry, physics, mathematics, statistics, microbiology, computer science, cyber security, environmental science, GIS/remote sensing, renewable energy...) and management (business administration, law, accounting, marketing, banking & finance, economics, purchasing & supply, entrepreneurship, taxation). PhD research must be relevant to the oil and gas industry.

nationality.note: Nigerians only, with a verified National Identity Number (NIN) and a certificate of state of origin. Past PTDF beneficiaries cannot apply for the same or a lower degree; current holders of another scholarship should not apply; part-time study is not funded; postgraduates already in their final year should not apply.

language.note: No English test; O-level credit in English Language (WAEC/SSCE/NECO) is required.

field.note: Only courses on PTDF's sponsored list (oil and gas, energy, related sciences and management/law). Check the list on the portal before applying.

timeline.interview_period: Shortlisted postgraduate applicants are invited to oral interviews before final selection

eligibility.field_restrictions: Only PTDF-approved courses at PTDF partner universities in the UK, Germany, France and Malaysia, relevant to the oil and gas industry and consistent with the applicant's previous studies (energy, petroleum, engineering, geosciences, environment, data/AI/robotics, cybersecurity, business and finance programmes appear on recent award lists). coverage_details.monthly_stipend: 2026 rates (UMA-based, updated every February): PhD 6.0 UMA = MXN 21,397.32/month; Master's and academic exchange 4.5 UMA = MXN 16,047.99/month; Specialty 4.0 UMA = MXN 14,264.88/month

eligibility.gpa_requirement: No national GPA minimum in the call; admission and nomination are handled by the SNP programme, and awards follow SNP categories and allocation criteria
eligibility.language_requirements: None set by Secihti (programmes are mostly taught in Spanish; each programme sets its own admission rules)
eligibility.field_restrictions: Any field, but only programmes registered in the SNP and eligible for scholarships (in-person 'escolarizados' and, under separate terms, eligible non-in-person programmes). Medical specialties have a separate call.

Not eligible: people with unpaid Secihti obligations, people seeking a degree level already obtained with a Secihti scholarship, people holding an equivalent Mexican-state scholarship for the same purpose, or anyone with an open application in another S190 call.

language.note: No English test for the scholarship. Each SNP programme sets its own admission requirements (often a foreign-language reading test).

field.note: Any discipline, as long as the programme is in the SNP and eligible for scholarships.

timeline.result_announcement: Through the Secihti scholarship system after each window; the scholarship agreement (CAB) must be signed by 27 November 2026 for the second period

name: TÜBİTAK BİDEB 2210-A General Domestic Master's Scholarship (2210-A Yurt İçi Genel Yüksek Lisans Burs Programı)
organization: TÜBİTAK – Scientist Support Programmes Presidency (BİDEB)

coverage_details.monthly_stipend: 16,500 TL/month (full scholarship) or 4,750 TL/month (partial scholarship for scholars in full-time paid work or running a business); rates valid from 1 January 2026
coverage_details.additional_allowances: Monthly stipend only, paid within the first 10 days of the following month, for up to 24 months (and never beyond the 6-semester maximum study period). Scholars who are also bursary holders on TÜBİTAK ARDEB/TEYDEB projects receive 22,500 TL/month (full) or 6,000 TL/month (partial) from 2210. TÜBİTAK does not pay tuition fees.

eligibility.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of the Republic of Turkey (T.C. vatandaşı) or Blue Card holders under Law No. 5901
eligibility.gpa_requirement: No fixed GPA minimum. Ranking score = 30% undergraduate GPA (converted to the 100-point scale with YÖK's table) + 10% English score + 50% ALES (60% for applicants not placed through the ÖSYM university exam) + up to 10 points from the ÖSYM undergraduate placement ranking. The committee sets the cut-off score each call.
eligibility.language_requirements: English score of at least 80 in YDS, e-YDS, YÖKDİL, e-YÖKDİL or TIPDİL taken within the last 5 years, or an equivalent score in an ÖSYM-recognised English test taken within the last 2 years
eligibility.field_restrictions: All fields, but only thesis-based master's programmes in Turkey (non-thesis programmes and special-student status are excluded). Applicants must be enrolled and in at most their 3rd semester (scientific preparation counts; foreign-language preparation year does not). Only one 2210 sub-programme (2210-A/C/D/E) per call.
eligibility.return_obligation: None: the scholarship is a merit award with no compulsory service or repayment if the call rules are kept. Payments are recovered with interest if the obligations are breached.

nationality.note: Turkish citizens or Blue Card (Mavi Kart) holders under Law 5901 only. TÜBİTAK staff cannot apply. People who already received a 2210 master's scholarship cannot apply again.

language.note: Requires an English score of 80+ in YDS/e-YDS/YÖKDİL/e-YÖKDİL/TIPDİL (last 5 years) or an equivalent score in an ÖSYM-recognised English test (last 2 years). TÜBİTAK publishes no IELTS equivalent; check ÖSYM's equivalence table before relying on IELTS or TOEFL. The master's itself is usually taught in Turkish, which Turkish citizens already speak.

field.note: Any field, thesis master's only. The priority-area (2210-C) and industry-oriented (2210-D) sub-programmes are separate calls with higher stipends.

timeline.typical_deadline: Two calls a year: late October (2026: 5–27 October, 17:30 TRT) and late March (2026: 2–24 March, 17:30 TRT)
timeline.result_announcement: Roughly 3 months after each call via e-BİDEB (the 2026 1st-call results page names only 2210-C/D, published 16 June 2026; no separate 2210-A date was listed)
timeline.course_start: Scholarship starts in October (autumn call) or March (spring call) of a master's you are already enrolled in

name: AIMS Structured Master's in Mathematical Sciences (full scholarship)
country: Africa (AIMS centres in South Africa, Senegal, Ghana, Cameroon, Rwanda)
organization: African Institute for Mathematical Sciences (AIMS) - Next Einstein Initiative network
